requirements.title: Straight key debounce
requirements.description: The keyer module shall debounce the straight key input with a 2 ms window and assert PTT within 3 ms.
requirements.rationale: Allocated from REQ-SYS-001; 2 ms + 3 ms leaves 0 ms margin to the 5 ms system budget with the hardware filter (ADR-001).
requirements.verification_note: Host cargo test with mocked GPIO timeline.

requirements.title: Iambic mode B element timing
requirements.description: The keyer module shall generate dits of 1200 ms divided by WPM and dahs of three dits, within 1 percent.
requirements.rationale: Allocated from REQ-SYS-002; PARIS timing standard.

requirements.title: Keyer speed persistence
requirements.description: The keyer module shall restore the last keyer speed from configuration memory within 100 ms of boot.
requirements.rationale: Self-derived: ADR-001 records the decision to persist keyer settings so the radio starts with a usable keyer; no parent requirement states it (02 section 2.3).
requirements.verification_note: Host cargo test with a mocked configuration store.
